Messages.Body:
Jean-Francois Caron <cam...@netrover.com> wrote:
> VampA enters combat with VampB;
> Combat is at close range;
> VampA plays Immortal Grapple;
> VampA strikes with Undead Strenght
>
> Is VampB allowed to strike with Majesty (S:CE) or
> can he only make hand strikes?

Per text of Immortal Grapple, both minions in combat are limited to hand
strikes only. Retainers and other non-strike effects are not affected.

Point of note: In official errata, the limitation to hand strikes is
only limited to the round it is played in. This is contrary to printed
text. However, you can play an additional IG on the additional rounds
to limit strikes.

Noal McDonald
